flat.protocol: 32 env, DR/push off, 2s warmup, fixed velocity and central EE commands; terrain is original generator 4x4; simulation performance only
flat.note: Contact fractions use instantaneous net-force norm>2N, not positive Fz or sole clearance. Baseline differs in model, EE frame/workspace/control; not a causal threshold ablation.
